weld.rule: exact-attribute weld (bitwise-equal position / normal / uv), degenerate triangles and unreferenced vertices dropped: lossless

processing.simplify: none: Meshy's triangle count is kept (held-weapon first-person density)
processing.rotation: rotateY(-90deg): (x, y, z) -> (-z, y, x); raw -X (muzzle / head) -> game -Z, raw -Z (the master's visible = the weapon's RIGHT side) -> game +X

ops.why: lane AG accept of R005: the short magazine is its own island
ops.name: Magazine

islands.rule: whole position-connected islands lying inside the box min [-0.02,-0.105,0.06] max [0.005,-0.01,0.135] (m)

ops.why: lead decision: the magazine island is thin (17.7 mm) and off the well; thickened across X to a plausible 24 mm and centred on the magazine well (x -0.0068, the receiver / barrel mid-plane)
ops.name: Magazine

scale.rule: the selection's X extent scaled about its own X centre, then centred on x = -0.0068; normals by the inverse transpose

pivot.rule: the top centre of the part (x / z centre, max y): the magazine well

Grip.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane)

Muzzle.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

Sight.rule: the rear face: z = the maximum z within {"y":[0.055,0.13],"z":[0,0.3]}; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

Eject.rule: x = the right-hand receiver surface (the right-most hit of a ray along X at y / z [0.005,0.11], beside the port)

processing.markerNotes: Sight: the scope's rear lens (the ocular face centre). The receiver, barrel, scope and stock share one mid-plane x ~ -0.007; the bounding box centre is pulled off it by the right-hand windage turret (the lane's raw +0.008 z note): no part is offset from another, so nothing is re-centred
